text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$107,101 to NT$99,922 before recovering to NT$102,194; a rebound does not erase the decline, and one brief period is not enough to judge a strategy.","Holding through these swings without trading avoided reacting to losses, but I should still check that my holdings and cash remain consistent with my goals and risk tolerance.","Because past price movements do not predict future ones, I should not buy or sell just because a stock has recently risen or fallen; any trade should have a clear, forward-looking rationale."]}
